name: Prostitute's Boat
summary:
This painting is from a set of 50 depicting the different types of boats that cluttered the Pearl River. It shows a 'shagu', a mobile brothel that plied the Pearl River. Paintings such as this were mass-produced as souvenir items.

Lord George Macartney (1737-1806) was the first British ambassador
